title: Daily maximum Mendenhall River gage height, 2013–2026
description: Daily maxima derived from the instantaneous stage record, with National Weather Service flood categories.
source: U.S. Geological Survey National Water Information System

provenance.querySummary: Annual instantaneous-value requests for parameter 00065, 2013-01-01 through 2026-09-05; grouped by Alaska local date.
provenance.timeEncoding: Continuous timestamps are ISO 8601 Alaska wall times with explicit UTC offsets, converted with America/Juneau. USGS UTC instants were retained during validation.
provenance.approvalStatus: USGS P qualifiers are represented as Provisional; other published instantaneous values are represented as Approved.

processing.method: Maximum instantaneous observation for each America/Juneau calendar day.
